title: Covering a Shift
transcript:
Man: Hey, any chance you could cover my shift at the café on Saturday morning?
Woman: Saturday? What time?
Man: Seven to eleven. My cousin's getting married, and I totally forgot when I signed up.
Woman: Seven's brutal. But I could use the hours.
Man: I'll take your Tuesday night shift in exchange, if you want.
Woman: Deal. Just tell the manager so it's official.
Man: I'll text her right now.

questions.stem: Why does the woman say, "Seven's brutal"?
options: She thinks the shift is too long.
She is annoyed that the man forgot.
She has another job on Saturday.
She doesn't like starting work so early.
questions.explanation: She's reacting to the 7 a.m. start time, which she finds unpleasant, though she still agrees.

questions.stem: What does the man offer the woman?
options: To pay her for the extra hours
To work one of her shifts
To invite her to the wedding
To talk to the manager for her later
questions.explanation: He says, "I'll take your Tuesday night shift in exchange."
